description: Source code for the BrowserType class and related interfaces in Playwright, handling browser launching, connection, and management.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: Represents a browser type in Playwright, providing methods to launch, connect, and manage browsers.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns the executable path of the browser, throws if not supported on current platform.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser type.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a new browser instance with specified options.

methods.name: launchServer
methods.description: Launches a browser server if supported.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with specified options.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to an existing browser instance via endpoint or options.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Internal method to connect to a browser with given parameters.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium browser over Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: _connectOverCDP
methods.description: Internal method to connect over CDP with specific endpoint URL.

methods.name: _connectOverCDPTransport
methods.description: Connects to a browser over an existing CDP transport.
